title: Fix a Low‑Contrast Component
description: Take a provided card component and adjust its CSS to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements.
hints: The light grey text (#999) on white (#f0f0f0) likely fails – consider darkening it to at least #757575.
The green price text (#0a0) on the light background may not meet 3:1 for large text; check and adjust.
The button's green background with white text needs 4.5:1 if the text is less than 24px; #0a0 is too bright.
expectedOutput: CSS code with updated colour values that pass AA contrast requirements.
